definitions: The practice of reducing resource consumption and waste by designing products and systems that can be reused, repaired, or recycled.

The ability to meet the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs, combined with an economic model that minimizes waste and makes the most of resources.
examples: Many companies are now focusing on sustainability and circularity.
The conference will explore the future of sustainability and circularity.
Investing in sustainability and circularity is crucial for the planet.
